newsitem.title: USA: PRI Automation shareholders approve split.
newsitem.headline: PRI Automation shareholders approve split.

text.p: PRI Automation Inc said that its shareholders have approved an increase in the company's authorized common shares, as required to implement a previously announced two-for-one stock split approved by its board on March 4.

The company said the split will be effected by the distribution on May 3 of a 100 percent stock dividend to shareholders of record on April 22. The shareholders' action has increased the number of shares of authorized common stock to 24 million, from 12 million.
PRI currently has about 7.8 million shares outstanding.
